name: Vector reproject
description: Transform vector feature coordinates from an explicitly declared source CRS to an explicitly declared target CRS.

target_crs.description: Target CRS as an authority/code pair or a WKT2 declaration.

preconditions: Input Artifact declares a resolvable source CRS.
Target CRS is an explicit authority/code or WKT2 declaration.
A non-ballpark coordinate operation must be available in the installed PROJ database.
Every input geometry is non-empty, valid, finite, and one of the declared vector geometry types.
Input axis order is interpreted as x/y regardless of authority axis metadata.
The operation does not repair geometries, densify segments, clip extents, or split antimeridian crossings.
validation_requirements: Output CRS equals the requested target CRS.
Feature count, IDs, properties, geometry types, and coordinate dimensionality are preserved.
Every output geometry is non-empty, valid, and finite.
